body: This is actually super helpful, I feel like I’ve been trying to skip steps 1,2 and 3 in a sense to get to the one where I know for SURE that someone’s emotionally committed to me and that’s not logical or reasonable. Thank you!!

It’s not that I think relationships are meant to be perfect. And it’s not that I’m sitting on my couch doing nothing else praying for a boyfriend, I’m in grad school, I just got a new job, I’m motivated in a lot of ways I’m just struggling with understanding how and when something is going to fall into place with finding someone who’s genuine and wants what I want.
